敵に捕らわれ、かつての敵に仕えることを強いられた源頼光。屈辱的な衣装を次々と着せられ、抗う心とは裏腹に、身体は異様な悦びに染まっていく…。誇り高き彼女が堕ちていく様を描く、背徳の物語。
(Captured by her foes Minamoto no Raikou is forced into servitude made to wear humiliating attire for her former enemies. While her spirit resists her body betrays her succumbing increasingly to perverse pleasure... A tale of forbidden sensations depicting the fall of a proud warrior.)
